Font-bearing companion to marketing-parity.pptx, from the same unmodified
presentation-2.pptx (source SHA256 recorded in marketing-fonts.json).

Retains all 28 slides, XML/relationships, and all 24 original compressed EOT
font parts. Nunito Sans and Poppins provide 400/500/600/700 normal and italic
faces (16 distinct faces; the package repeats bold variants). The manifest
pins every original font binary's SHA256. Font binaries are not rewritten.
Raster media is omitted: this is a text test fixture, not a complete visual
presentation to upload or a replacement for the PowerPoint reference deck.

PowerPoint is the source of truth. Source overlaps are not editor defects.
Known weight/alignment/wrapping differences remain open. The browser tests
verify actual embedded-face selection, not parity with native PowerPoint's
rasterizer. Their layout.json and screenshots are diagnostic evidence, not
approved visual goldens. Do not update expectations to bless a discrepancy.

Run:
  yarn test font-bearing-fixture --runInBand
  yarn test:pptx-fonts --runInBand

The second command requires Chrome (or CHROME_PATH), uses an isolated temporary
profile, blocks HTTP(S) font fallback, checks all 16 faces before/after export,
checks the actual faces used by every text run on all 28 slides, and verifies
that the fontless companion fails the embedded-face condition. Measurements
and selected screenshots are written to .headless-evidence/pptx-fonts/.

Rebuild from the original source, without changing any retained bytes:
  node src/elements/components/PptxEditor/tests/font-parity/make-fixture.cjs /path/to/presentation-2.pptx

For native parity acceptance, compare the original deck in PowerPoint with
the hosted editor at the same canvas dimensions. Check slide 6 regular/italic
body weight, slide 12 headings/labels/baselines, and wraps on slides 7 and 14.
Never treat CSS weight strings or passing font-load tests as visual approval.
